race.description: Crjc Premiership Winners Race Day Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: SIZZLING SUZIE (6) resumes from a lengthy break. Closed strongly on debut with a sound third over 1000m at Port Macquarie last October. Latest trial was okay and kicks off in a winnable race.  KOBI EXPRESS (2) came out quickly from the good draw and folded up late when tenth here over 1000m. Assess on the good second two back. Expected to run well. PRESTIGE EXOTIC (9) Cosmic Force three-year-old gelding out of Exotic Escape on debut for the Lee yard. Has shown potential at the trials and maps well with the winkers going on. IBETTY (11) chipped away late on debut when fifth over 1006m at this track. Further improved now and worth thought.
